messages:
oliver: hey team  urgent billing problem. my dentist submitted my root canal claim under my spouse's member ID by mistake. insurer denied for member mismatch and now clinic says i owe $620. any way to fix without paying out of pocket?

zoe-benefits: ugh. did the clinic bill with the wrong subscriber info or did they attach spouse's insurance id to your chart?

oliver: invoice shows subscriber: Sara L. (spouse). my spouse and i are both on the plan but i'm the patient. clinic billing says it was a data entry error.

claims-bot: common fix: provider corrects and re-submits claim with correct subscriber/member ID, or provider submits a void and replacement claim. Required: itemized bill, original claim number, member IDs, and a provider corrected claim form. Timeline: reprocess 14-45 days after resubmission.

billing-bot: sample request you can send to billing@dentist.example: 
```
To: billing@dentist.example
Subject: Request to correct submitted claim - Patient: Oliver R. (DOB: 1992-02-10)

Hi 3 billing team 3 My root canal on 05/02/2025 (Account: 334455) appears to have been billed with the subscriber ID for Sara L. (my spouse). That caused a denial for member mismatch. Please void the original claim (Claim#: 998877) and re-submit a corrected claim using the correct subscriber/member information for Oliver R. (Member ID: 7771234). If you need a signed patient authorization form we can provide one.

Thanks,
Oliver R.
Mobile: 555-0199
```

oliver: clinic says they can correct but need a signed release to talk to insurer. is that normal?

zoe-benefits: yes, providers often need an ROI (release of information) or signed patient auth to discuss claims. you can sign a simple authorization at the clinic or email a brief consent. also forward any confirmation emails to benefits@redwood.com so we can help chase.

tom-broker: if provider re-bills correctly but insurer still denies, have the provider include a cover letter explaining the billing error. broker can escalate to carrier rep if claim hangs >30 days or if provider pushes back. ping me and i'll open a broker case.

claims-bot: checklist to upload with your appeal/rebilling: [Original itemized bill, denial EOB, signed ROI or patient auth, screenshot of member card for Oliver, copy of spouse's ID showing family coverage, provider corrected claim confirmation]. Use subject: "Claim Correction: Oliver R. 05/02/2025" when emailing benefits.

oliver: done 3 i signed the clinic ROI and emailed billing. forwarded docs to benefits@redwood.com with subject "Claim Correction: Oliver R. 05/02/2025". thanks for the quick help.

zoe-benefits: got it 3 i'll follow up with billing and carrier contact. if they insist on payment up front, keep receipts and we'll file for reimbursement after reprocessing. usually insurer will either pay provider directly or issue refund to you.

oliver: great, appreciate it. i'll update here when clinic confirms re-submission. :thumbsup:
